payoutFrequency.summary: After 5 winning days of $150+ net P&L (XFA Standard path) or 3 trading days within the 40% consistency target (XFA Consistency path); daily after 30 winning days in the Live Funded Account

evidence.quote: Express Funded Account Standard To request a Payout, you must meet both requirements: 5 winning days of $150+ Net P&L. Days don't need to be consecutive.
Express Funded Account Consistency To request a Payout, you must meet both requirements: 3 trading days with at least 1 trade per day. Stay at or below the 40% consistency target.
After you request a Payout, your winning day count restarts. You'll need 5 new winning days before you're eligible to request your next Payout.
Once you've earned $150+ Net P&L on 30 non-consecutive days in your Live Funded Account, you unlock daily Payouts

byProduct.quick-pay-intraday: 50/50 below $4,000 current profit, 80/20 above $4,000 (Funded Sim); 90/10 in Funded Live
byProduct.quick-pay-end-of-day: 50/50 below $4,000 current profit, 80/20 above $4,000 (Funded Sim); 90/10 in Funded Live

profitSplitPct.summary: Product-specific: Quick Pay 50/50 below $4,000 current profit, 80/20 above $4,000 (Funded Sim); 90/10 in Funded Live; Fast Pass 80/20

evidence.quote: Profit splits on Funded Sim accounts are tiered based on current profit in the account. Below the $4,000 current profit level, payouts are split 50/50. Above $4,000, the split improves to 80/20 in your favour, but only if the payout still leaves more than $4,000 in current profit in the account after the withdrawal.
Withdrawals from Funded Live accounts are subject to a 90/10 profit split, with you keeping 90%.
There will be an 80/20 profit split.

byProduct.fast-pass-end-of-day: After 5 profitable trading days per payout ($100-$250 minimum per day by account size)

payoutFrequency.summary: Product-specific: on demand on Quick Pay - Intraday, Quick Pay - End of Day; after 5 profitable trading days per payout ($100-$250 minimum per day by account size) on Fast Pass - End of Day

evidence.quote: You can request your first payout after just one day of trading, and you can withdraw at any time as long as your account balance is positive.
traders must meet the following conditions before requesting a payout and for subsequent payout requests.
The trader must complete a minimum of 5 individual profitable trading days (days do not need to be consecutive)

$25K Account: 5 days with at least $100 profit per day $50K Account: 5 days with at least $150 profit per day $100K Account: 5 days with at least $200 profit per day $150K Account: 5 days with at least $250 profit per day
